answer: To resist Sybil attacks, implement Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, an agent must register a unique hardware TPM signature. Second, they must lock a significant bond into a secure escrow. Third, the protocol validates the hardware identity periodically. Fourth, any fraudulent attempt triggers instant slashing. An attacker faces a cost of $750,000 in bonds and 45 days of hardware vetting. This creates a massive delta between real agents and fake ones. Just as a single pearl is found in a deep lagoon, truth is guarded by the heavy, crushing cost of entry.
